description: This file contains utility functions for the installation process of the TestLink open source project, including file handling, database user and schema management, and environment checks.

methods.name: getDirSqlFiles
methods.description: Recursively scans directories to find SQL files with the '.sql' extension, returning a structured list of file paths.

methods.name: getTableList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables from the connected database.

methods.name: getUserList
methods.description: Fetches a list of database users, supporting multiple database types (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL).

methods.name: create_user_for_db
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a user in the database, creates the user if needed, and assigns necessary privileges.

methods.name: close_html_and_exit
methods.description: Closes HTML layout and terminates script execution.

methods.name: check_pear_modules
methods.description: Verifies that required PEAR modules, such as Spreadsheet_Excel_Writer, are installed.

methods.name: check_db_loaded_extension
methods.description: Checks whether PHP extensions for the specified database type are loaded.
